claim: Under identical SFT settings, direct SFT improves B4O-Feasible from 60.47% to 65.93% and B4O-ORGEval from 34.26% to 48.73%; with CPT initialization, the corresponding scores further increase to 71.22% and 59.39%.
falsifier: On the same SFT tasks and settings, compare performance with and without CPT initialization to verify the improvement.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported SFT settings, tasks (B4O-Feasible, B4O-ORGEval), and model; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: CPT initialization before SFT–B4O-Feasible and B4O-ORGEval scores…
